# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)
- **数据绑定**: [data-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/data-binding.md)
- **列表渲染 (wx:for)**: [list-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/list-render.md)
- **条件渲染 (wx:if)**: [conditional-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/conditional-render.md)
- **事件处理**: [event.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/event.md)
- **样式处理 (CSS)**: [css.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/css.md)
- **Class 与 Style 绑定**: [class-style-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/class-style-binding.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。
- **响应式原理**: [reactive.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/reactive.md) - 包含 watch, computed 等。
- **双向绑定**: [two-way-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/two-way-binding.md) - wx:model 语法。
- **引用 (Refs)**: [refs.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/refs.md)

## 6. 其他
- **生命周期**: [lifecycle.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/lifecycle.md)

<template>
  <view class="feed-page">
    <scroll-view
      class="feed-scroll"
      scroll-y
      scroll-top="{{scrollTop}}"
      scroll-with-animation="{{false}}"
      bindscroll="onScroll"
      bindtouchstart="onTouchStart"
      bindtouchmove="onTouchMove"
      bindtouchend="onTouchEnd"
      bindtouchcancel="onTouchEnd"
    >
      <view class="feed-content" data-content-version="{{contentVersion}}">
        <view class="categories">
          <view
            wx:for="{{categories}}"
            wx:key="id"
            class="category {{activeCategoryId === item.id ? 'category--active' : ''}}"
            data-category-id="{{item.id}}"
            bindtap="selectCategory"
          >
            <text>{{item.name}}</text>
          </view>
        </view>

        <view wx:for="{{products}}" wx:key="id" class="product">
          <image
            class="product-image"
            src="{{item.image}}"
            mode="widthFix"
            bindload="onImageLoad"
            binderror="onImageError"
          />
          <product-video wx:if="{{item.video}}" product="{{item}}" />
        </view>
      </view>
    </scroll-view>

    <view class="fixed-cart" bindtap="openCart">
      <text>购物车 {{cartCount}}</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    categories: [],
    products: [],
    cartCount: 2,
    activeCategoryId: '',
    contentVersion: 0,
    scrollTop: 0,
    isDragging: false
  },
  async onLoad () {
    const { data } = await mpx.request({ url: '/api/feed' })
    const categories = data.categories || []
    this.setData({
      categories,
      products: data.products || [],
      activeCategoryId: categories.length ? categories[0].id : ''
    })
  },
  methods: {
    selectCategory (event) {
      this.setData({ activeCategoryId: event.currentTarget.dataset.categoryId })
    },
    onScroll (event) {
      this.scrollTop = event.detail.scrollTop || 0
    },
    onImageLoad () {
      // widthFix changes the item height after the image is available. Updating a
      // bound value lets scroll-view recalculate its content extent on every end.
      this.setData({ contentVersion: this.contentVersion + 1 })
    },
    onImageError () {
      this.setData({ contentVersion: this.contentVersion + 1 })
    },
    onTouchStart (event) {
      const touch = event.touches && event.touches[0]
      if (!touch) return
      this.dragStart = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY }
      this.dragAxis = ''
      this.setData({ isDragging: false })
    },
    onTouchMove (event) {
      const touch = event.touches && event.touches[0]
      if (!touch || !this.dragStart) return
      const deltaX = touch.clientX - this.dragStart.x
      const deltaY = touch.clientY - this.dragStart.y
      if (!this.dragAxis && (Math.abs(deltaX) > 8 || Math.abs(deltaY) > 8)) {
        this.dragAxis = Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY) ? 'x' : 'y'
      }
      // Only expose a horizontal drag as a gesture. Vertical motion remains the
      // scroll-view's native scroll so momentum and page reachability are intact.
      if (this.dragAxis === 'x' && !this.isDragging) {
        this.setData({ isDragging: true })
      }
    },
    onTouchEnd () {
      this.dragStart = null
      this.dragAxis = ''
      if (this.isDragging) this.setData({ isDragging: false })
    },
    openCart () {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/cart/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "usingComponents": {
    "product-video": "../../components/product-video"
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>

.fixed-cart {

}
</style>
<template>
  <view class="product-video">
    <video
      id="product-video-{{product.id}}"
      class="video"
      src="{{product.video}}"
      poster="{{product.image}}"
      autoplay="{{true}}"
      muted="{{true}}"
      loop="{{true}}"
      controls="{{false}}"
      show-center-play-btn="{{true}}"
      enable-progress-gesture="{{true}}"
      object-fit="cover"
      bindtimeupdate="onTimeUpdate"
      bindloadedmetadata="onLoadedMetadata"
      bindplay="onPlay"
      bindpause="onPause"
      bindended="onEnded"
      binderror="onVideoError"
    />
    <text class="video-progress">{{progress}} / {{duration}}</text>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    product: { type: Object, value: () => ({}) }
  },
  data: {
    progress: 0,
    duration: 0,
    isPlaying: false,
    videoSize: ''
  },
  methods: {
    onTimeUpdate (event) {
      const detail = event.detail || {}
      this.setData({
        progress: Math.floor(detail.currentTime || 0),
        duration: Math.floor(detail.duration || this.duration || 0)
      })
    },
    onLoadedMetadata (event) {
      const detail = event.detail || {}
      this.setData({
        duration: Math.floor(detail.duration || 0),
        videoSize: `${detail.width || 0}x${detail.height || 0}`
      })
    },
    onPlay () {
      this.setData({ isPlaying: true })
    },
    onPause () {
      this.setData({ isPlaying: false })
    },
    onEnded () {
      this.setData({ isPlaying: false, progress: 0 })
    },
    onVideoError () {
      this.setData({ isPlaying: false })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.product-video {

}

}
